# Fork publication boundary

Exactly 1160 files below belong on the fork branch. No commit, push or publication is performed. Staging verification uses only a scratch copy under /tmp.

| Files | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| Root README, licences, ignore rules and this manifest | Result, ownership and boundary. |
| acceptance/ scripts, manifests, test sources, patch, reports and evidence | Offline replay, controls, bounded claims and reviewable receipts. |
| acceptance/intree/ | Portable native replay, including the review CARGO_HOME edit, formatting settings and third-party licence notices. |
| acceptance/evidence/intree/replay/ | Final polished-patch baseline, 19 per-mutant coretests and doc-test logs, and summary. Parent-directory intree/logs/b copies are historical. |
| published/ | Unchanged Rust source snapshots and toolchain identity metadata; historical versions are comparison inputs. |
| upstream-tests-1.99.0/ | Exact tag test inputs. |
| spec/ and known/ | Normative snapshots, registry data and partial known-item metadata. |
| history/missing-tests-brief2-files-only.md and history/brief2-files-only-evidence/ | Historical file-only result used by report.py; explicitly predates the doc-test port and revised M095. |

Excluded: internal run directories, the native checkout, the unused work-rust-std-net copy, the run-1 package archive, redundant evidence/gen/before receipts, all caches and targets, crash reports, and all internal BRIEF documents. Toolchain metadata and historical receipt paths were normalized; original bytes remain in internal archives. Original and normalized toolchain hashes are in acceptance/evidence/gen/toolchain-normalization.json; native copy hashes are in acceptance/evidence/intree/copy-manifest.json; historical path-normalization hashes are in acceptance/evidence/gen/history-normalization.json. Source snapshots were not modified.

The following list is exhaustive, with paths relative to the folder root. Regenerate and check it with `python3 acceptance/publication.py`. The check runs recursive grep across these exact files for absolute macOS home paths. It also initializes a scratch Git repository under /tmp, copies these files, stages with `git add -A` and compares `git ls-files` with this list. The staging proof and final native receipt checks, including the review CARGO_HOME edit, are recorded in acceptance/evidence/gen/publication-replay.txt.
